comparison.objective: Relay a frozen sample between cold boxes within a temperature-exposure deadline, not adjust a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed transfer and bimanual workspace handoff; no setscrew/collar manipulation or dynamic-response tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Sample reaches the destination through the middle pad within 20 seconds, with partial credit at 30/45 seconds; no stopping-performance test.
comparison.reason: Tests timed cold-chain handling and reach coordination.
